author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಮನದ ಕದವನು ಮುಚ್ಚಿ ನಿನ್ನೊಳಗೆ ಮಾತಾಡು
ತನುವಲಿಹ ಕಲ್ಮಶವ ಹೆಕ್ಕಿ ಹೊರಹಾಕು
ಅನುಸರಿಸು ಚಿತ್ತನುಡಿ ಅನುಕರಿಸೆ ಹಿರಿಯನಡೆ
ಸನಿಹದಲೆ ಗೆಲುವುಂಟು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Close the door of your mind and talk within yourself;
pick out the impurities in you and throw them out;
follow the voice of your heart, imitate the conduct of the elders,
and victory is close at hand, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Spend time in quiet self-examination. Remove what is impure, listen to your conscience, follow good examples, and success is near.
